description: This file defines the ManageController class which handles user account management actions such as profile viewing and editing, password management, two-factor authentication setup, external login linking, and recovery code handling within an ASP.NET Core web application.

classes.name: ManageController
classes.description: Controller class for managing user account settings, including profile, password, 2FA, external logins, and recovery codes.

methods.name: MyAccount
methods.description: Displays the current user's profile information.

methods.name: MyAccount (POST)
methods.description: Updates user's email and phone number.

methods.name: SendVerificationEmail
methods.description: Sends a new email confirmation link to the user.

methods.name: ChangePassword
methods.description: Displays change password view if user has a password.

methods.name: ChangePassword (POST)
methods.description: Handles submission to change the user's password.

methods.name: SetPassword
methods.description: Displays set password view if user does not have one.

methods.name: SetPassword (POST)
methods.description: Handles setting a new password for the user.

methods.name: ExternalLogins
methods.description: Displays current external logins linked to the user.

methods.name: LinkLogin
methods.description: Initiates linking an external login provider.

methods.name: LinkLoginCallback
methods.description: Completes linking an external login provider.

methods.name: RemoveLogin
methods.description: Removes an external login from the user's account.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Displays the 2FA settings page.

methods.name: Disable2faWarning
methods.description: Displays warning before disabling 2FA.

methods.name: Disable2fa
methods.description: Disables two-factor authentication for the user.

methods.name: EnableAuthenticator
methods.description: Displays the page to enable authenticator app for 2FA.

methods.name: ShowRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Displays the recovery codes for 2FA.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticatorWarning
methods.description: Displays warning before resetting authenticator app key.

methods.name: ResetAuthenticator
methods.description: Resets the authenticator app key for the user.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodes
methods.description: Generates new 2FA recovery codes.

methods.name: GenerateRecoveryCodesWarning
methods.description: Warning before generating new recovery codes.
